events.title: Arrival
events.description: Nicola Cognetta, 23, single, SS Regina d'Italia, father Giovanni at Dasà, to brother Francesco in Stamford

bioAdditions: Nicola Cognetta, born at Dasà about 1886-87, was the son of a Giovanni Cognetta of Dasà. He had been in Connecticut before, probably arriving in December 1903 as a 17-year-old shoemaker bound for Stamford. In May 1910 he returned to Stamford to join his brother Francesco on Branch Street. If, as the family tree holds, Frank Cognetti of Scranton was Giovanni's son, Nicola was Frank's elder brother, and he carried the name of their grandfather, Mastro Nicola Cognetta. Not to be confused with the older Nicola Cognetta of Dasà (b. c.1870, shoemaker, wife Maria, sons Pasquale and Giuseppe), who went to Stamford in 1911 and 1916.

relationships.evidence: 1910 manifest: joining 'brother Francesco' in Stamford; 1905 manifest: Francesco Cognetta of Dasà joining 'brother Nicola, Stamford'. Identity of Francesco with Frank of Scranton unproven.
